intro: Measured on one machine (Windows 11, Intel 13900K, RTX 4090) against the author's own retail console package. Every row below is an outcome the project produces, not a plan; the commands that produce them are in the Build section, and the failures behind each number are in docs/boot_frontier.md.

stages.evidence: the executable's image maps at its preferred base, imports resolve through shims, static TLS is redirected for 53,246 slot-0 reads, heap and file system come from the host
26,616 SPIR-V modules indexed; the boot loads 27,890 translated entries with 0 pipeline failures

device, queues, fences, allocators, descriptor heaps and command lists answer; the queue's two-method slot shift, the fence completed-value address, the command-list lifecycle, the clear and barrier conversions, the display-resource creation and the derived-pipeline path are measured and mapped
factory, files, queues and the zlib path serve 4,096 requests / 256 MiB at 131-144 MiB/s with every status entry S_OK; packed and swizzled reads refuse rather than guess
the title boots and runs its own loop past 300 s with no exception
the frame records, closes and submits: 88,128 Close calls succeed with 0 failed, ~66,500 frames submitted per 300 s run, console queue slot 35 wired as the submit
all 10,241 graphics records build into real pipelines (0 refusals) after the input-layout element table was decoded, and the derived-pipeline path creates 41,545 more with 0 failures
42,722 draws recorded and executed per 150 s run with 0 refused submissions after the title's page VAs were put into the GPU address space; page content for buffers is pulled (273 MiB per 300 s)
the runtime's own window is up and presents 33,275 frames per 300 s run with 0 failed present calls

the presented 4K display resource is written by the frame's draws but reads back uniformly black; the pipeline stand-ins and the copy path are falsified, and the remaining measured gaps are the texture-data path (CPU-built texture bytes never reach the GPU image) and the streamed-block consumer

counts.what: Draws recorded and executed per 150 s run

counts.value: 4,096 requests / 256 MiB at 131-144 MiB/s, all status S_OK
the presented display resource reads back uniformly black

frontier.stop: no stop - the title runs, draws and presents; the presented frame is still black
frontier.summary: the title boots, runs past 300 s, records and executes its draws with 0 refused submissions and presents 33,275 frames to the runtime's own window. The presented 4K display resource is proven writable (a write control reads back exactly) and the frame's draws target it, but its own output reads back uniformly black. The fixed-function stand-ins and the copy path are falsified; the measured remaining gaps are the texture-data path (the title's CPU-built texture bytes do not reach the GPU image) and the unnamed consumer of the streamed blocks.

next: make a title-placed texture's GPU image read the title's pages, so the CPU-built texture bytes the XG path writes become visible content
name the consumer of the streamed 64 KiB blocks (caller-RVA logging on the device entry points)
decode the texture-layout slots that still refuse (GetResourceLayout record, tile list)
decode the serialized fixed-function state blob (behavioural probes) so the pipeline state is measured, not a stand-in
